name: Booster K1
summary: K1 is a compact 95 cm, 19.5 kg humanoid sold as an entry-level development platform for education, research and exhibitions. It comes in Geek, Education and Professional editions that differ in compute and battery.
sensors: Binocular stereo depth camera, 9-axis IMU, microphone array and speaker.
highlights: K1 won the KidSize category at RoboCup Soccer 2025, per Generation Robots.
Generation Robots lists K1 from EUR 7,500 excl. VAT (EUR 9,000 incl. VAT).
SDK support for Python and C++.
caveats: The USD 4,999 figure is a launch starting price reported by press; regional prices differ.
The Geek edition has only about 20 minutes of walking runtime.

sources.title: Booster Robotics Launches K1: A RoboCup-Winning Humanoid for $5,000
